hook.name: PurplXV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% fee on every swap (1% to creator, 0.5% to protocol treasury) by intercepting the input currency via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-output) and AfterSwapDelta (exact-input), minting ERC-6909 claims to the hook and treasury. Pools must be registered by a factory before swaps execute; creator fees accumulate as claims and are redeemable on demand.
